name: neta-art-benchmark-prompts
description: A collection of prompts intended for evaluating text-to-image (art) generation systems. The set provides varied artistic and stylistic prompts to probe a model's ability to follow creative instructions and produce diverse, high-quality images. It is typically used in conjunction with subjective human evaluation and automated image-quality/semantic alignment metrics.
evaluation_method: Human evaluation (subjective quality/alignment) and/or automated image metrics such as CLIPScore, FID, or IS depending on experiment
general_score_metric: Human evaluation scores (subjective preference/faithfulness) and automated metrics like CLIPScore or FID
reputation: A niche Hugging Face-hosted prompt collection used by practitioners of generative art and prompt-engineering; limited broad benchmarking adoption.
